text: Thanks for joining.
speaker: Me

text: This is the monthly support review, so let's start with the numbers
speaker: Me

text: and then go through the two escalations.
speaker: Me

text: Sure.
speaker: Others

text: Ticket volume was up eighteen percent on last month, mostly after the
speaker: Others

text: invoicing change went out on the third.
speaker: Others

text: First response time slipped badly.
speaker: Others

text: The median was nine hours, against our target of two.
speaker: Others

text: Some people waited more than a day before anyone replied.
speaker: Others

text: That's the part that worries me. What happened?
speaker: Me

text: Two of the team were out sick in the same week, and the weekend rota had a gap.
speaker: Others

text: Nobody was covering Saturday at all.
speaker: Others

text: Okay. Let's fix the rota before anything else.
speaker: Me

text: I'd like a named person on every weekend shift, with a backup.
speaker: Me

text: I can draft that today and share it in the channel.
speaker: Others

text: Great. Now the escalations. The first was the hospital group?
speaker: Me

text: Yes. Their exports were failing every night for a week.
speaker: Others

text: It turned out a file was bigger than the limit on our
speaker: Others

text: side, so the job just stopped without telling anyone.
speaker: Others

text: So the customer found out before we did.
speaker: Me

text: They did, and they weren't happy.
speaker: Others

text: We've added an alert for failed exports, and engineering raised the size limit.
speaker: Others

text: Good. And the second one?
speaker: Me

text: A reseller in Canada was charged twice for the same quarter.
speaker: Others

text: Finance refunded it within a day, but they want a written explanation for their accountant.
speaker: Others

text: Let's send that this week. I'll write it with finance.
speaker: Me

text: One more thing. Customers keep asking for a status page.
speaker: Others

text: When something breaks, they email us to ask whether it's them or us.
speaker: Others

text: That's a good point.
speaker: Me

text: A public status page would take a lot of that load off.
speaker: Me

text: Let's put it on the roadmap for next quarter.
speaker: Me

text: Should I collect how many tickets were really just people asking if we were down?
speaker: Others

text: Yes, please. Numbers will help make the case.
speaker: Me

text: Last item: satisfaction scores. Anything unusual?
speaker: Me

text: Scores dropped from ninety-one to eighty-four, almost all from the slow replies.
speaker: Others

text: The answers themselves still rate well.
speaker: Others

text: Then the plan is clear.
speaker: Me

text: Fix the weekend cover first, then the status page.
speaker: Me

text: Thanks everyone.
